messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy started for staging 
deploy-bot: env=staging, release_tag=rc-2026-03-20a, commit=abc1234, triggered_by=alice
deploy-bot: migration job `run_migrations_v42` starting against `redwood_prod` (schema changes: add_index/column)
alice: thanks, watching. I'll start smoke tests once migrations report success. ping @raj for DB watch
raj: on it. estimated runtime ~2m for small ops, index build might take longer if table hot. if >5m we should pause canary.
deploy-bot: migration `run_migrations_v42` step 1/3: applied `add_column users.last_activity` -> OK
deploy-bot: migration `run_migrations_v42` step 2/3: starting `create_index on events(timestamp)` -> background index
marta: heads up — that index previously caused btree lock during a spike. can we run with CONCURRENTLY?
alice: deployment config used non-concurrent for safety in this branch. we can switch to concurrent but it won't run in the same migration step. thinking: either proceed and monitor or abort migration and rerun with concurrent in next window.
raj: if we abort now we'll need to run a rollback for the schema change we already applied (`last_activity`) — that's safe. index is the real risk.
tyler: product note: canary users will see slight delay if index locks. prefer rollback and replan for next change window with concurrent index.
alice: +1 for rollback. initiating rollback of index step and tag pin.
deploy-bot: Initiating rollback commands:
```
./deploy rollback --env=staging --release=rc-2026-03-20a --target=pre-migration
./db/migrations/revert.sh run_migrations_v42
```
deploy-bot: Rollback: revert `add_column users.last_activity` -> SUCCESS
deploy-bot: Rollback: revert `create_index` step not applied -> N/A
raj: confirmed DB is back to pre-deploy state, no locks present.
alice: pinning release to stable tag v1.12.3 for staging to restore canary traffic.
deploy-bot: New active release in staging: v1.12.3 (commit=def5678), migration jobs cleared.
marta: good call. I'll update the release notes and mark this deploy as "blocked-by-migration-plan" and schedule new change window.
tyler: note for ops: schedule index with `CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY` in maintenance window and include read-replica backfill plan.
alice: file issue with migration plan + expected runtime + fallback steps. y'all ok if I re-run a small smoke deploy (no schema changes) to verify app binary?
raj: yes, run binary-only canary. I'll keep DB watch.
deploy-bot: Deploy finished for staging (binary-only canary): tag=staging-smoke-2026-03-20, commit=abc1234, status=PASS
alice: smoke looks green. closing thread, creating follow-up ticket: MIG-294-plan-index-concurrently
